item.title: It is time for a New Deal for mathematics
item.description: arXiv:2611.04213v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The AI labs' vision is based on extraction (of data, wealth, and political power). Mathematicians must oppose it, moving past personal reflections and towards reforming mathematics' social contract.
item.dc:creator: Nestor Guillen

item.title: Derived Equivalences for Terminal Threefold Flops via Local Index-One Covering Models
item.description: arXiv:2611.04844v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Inspired by the quadratic involutions of Corti-Pukhlikov-Reid and Gavin Brown's description of hypersurface flips via toric GIT, we apply similar symmetries to local covering models of terminal threefold flops. We recover the derived equivalence of their canonical stacks by pullback and pushforward along the fibre product over the canonical stack of the contraction target, revisiting the local picture in Kawamata's work.
item.dc:creator: Xingbang Hao

item.title: The Wandering Must Continue: Pure Mathematicians as Rangers of the North
item.description: arXiv:2610.26290v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Pure mathematics is an honest barometer of a civilization's scientific capacity, maintaining an unwritten culture of rigor, structural perception, and intellectual honesty whose primary service is not merely proving theorems, but cultivating human judgment. In an era of automated theorem generation and formal verification, this essay argues that establishing a result and understanding both why it holds and why it matters remain distinct achievements, and outlines concrete institutional mechanisms to protect the exploratory core of the discipline.
item.dc:creator: Jun-Yong Park
